25:33.text: And no example or similitude do they bring
(to oppose or to find fault in you or in this Qur’ân)
, but We reveal to you the truth

25:34.text: Those who will be gathered to Hell
on their faces, such will be in an evil state, and most astray from the

25:36.text: And We said: "Go you both to the people who have denied Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
." Then We destroyed them with utter destruction.

25:37.text: people, when they denied the Messengers, We drowned them, and We made them as a sign for mankind. And We have prepared a painful torment for the Zâlimûn

25:38.text: ‘Âd and Thamûd, and the Dwellers of Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.

25:39.text: (because of their disbelief and evil deeds)

25:40.text: And indeed they have passed by the town
on which was rained the evil rain. Did they
? Nay! But they used not to expect any resurrection.

25:41.text: , they treat you only in mockery
: "Is this the one whom Allâh has sent as a Messenger?

25:42.text: "He would have nearly misled us from our âlihah
, had it not been that we were patient and constant in their worship!" And they will know when they see the torment, who it is that is most astray from the

25:43.text: seen him who has taken as his ilâh
his own vain desire? Would you then be a Wakîl
